title: Make TASK-0041 measurable and close the design gap in STORY-0019
summary: Rewrites TASK-0041's done_when, which referred to the unresolved refs r1/r2, as a verifiable design document. Widens its scope to the full prompt and brief layout, including REQ-0059's next action. Adds a compaction-hook feasibility check. Adds design task TASK-0053 for the decisions record kind and makes TASK-0046 depend on it.
rationale: Review of TASK-0041: its kind (design) and story (STORY-0017) are correct, and it does not overlap TASK-0042, which builds what it designs. Four problems: (1) done_when names changeset refs r1/r2 that were never resolved to REQ ids (an error in CS-0019) and names no artifact, so it can't be checked; (2) brief ordering is required by both REQ-0058 AC2 (snapshot after the task section) and REQ-0059 AC3 (next action first) but no task designs the combined layout; (3) re-supplying the snapshot after compaction depends on a SessionStart hook that has not been verified for headless 'claude -p --resume' chat turns or agent runs; (4) among its sibling stories, STORY-0019 adds a record kind across schema, MCP, CSV and UI with no design task.

patch.description: Write design/context-management.md (design document format, REQ-0054) defining: (1) the snapshot changeset op and its validation; (2) the layout of the chat prompt and coding-agent brief, in order: task next_action, task section, snapshot, with the snapshot marked as project state; (3) when the chat agent is asked to propose next actions and a snapshot Next; (4) how the snapshot is re-supplied after compaction, verified for headless 'claude -p --resume' chat turns and agent runs, with a fallback (re-supply every turn) if the SessionStart compact hook does not fire.
patch.done_when: design/context-management.md is committed with realises [REQ-0057, REQ-0058, REQ-0059], has a section addressing each acceptance criterion of REQ-0057 and REQ-0058 and REQ-0059 AC3-AC4, records the compaction-hook test result, and lint reports 0 unknown realises ids.
